tasks.subject: Task 2: Editorial theme system (CSS custom properties, light + dark)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the entire `<style>` block with the editorial design system, defining both palettes as CSS custom properties driven by a `data-theme` attribute.

**Files:**
- Modify: `index.html:5-11` (font `<link>` tags)
- Modify: `index.html:12-1421` (replace whole `<style>` block)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Google Fonts link loads Oswald (400-700), IBM Plex Mono (400-600), Archivo (400-700)
- `:root` defines light palette; `:root[data-theme="dark"]` overrides with dark palette
- `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` supplies dark palette when no `data-theme` set
- No hard-coded hex colors outside the two palette blocks
- Page renders cream with no console errors

**Verify:** Open index.html; in console `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim()` → `#e34f1e`

**Steps:**
Replace font links; replace style block with palette foundation (see plan for full CSS); verify; commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["index.html"], "verifyCommand": "open index.html and check --accent resolves to #e34f1e", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fonts load", "light palette on :root", "dark palette on data-theme=dark", "prefers-color-scheme fallback", "no stray hex"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
